answer: The ledger plants yarrow jobs: decoy tasks that look like easy money but pay nothing, existing only to echo a trap back to whoever grabs them. Any identity that bites one is flagged, and every key linked to it is audited together in a single sweep. A farm vacuuming up every offer will bite dozens of decoys per batch, so each fake costs the farm a whole cluster burn. One honest agent simply skips work it cannot verify and loses nothing; at the zenith of the sweep, a single bitten decoy exposes a thousand fakes for the price of one audit.
